content.short: Nucast is a decentralized digital media platform on Cardano empowering creators with true ownership.
content.description: Nucast is a pioneering digital media ecosystem built on Cardano, designed to give creators and users true ownership of their content. The platform offers decentralized video streaming, a robust livestreaming service, and NFT ticketing for virtual and physical events. By leveraging nucastAI and a unique reputation protocol, Nucast provides a transparent environment where users can buy, watch, and resell digital content. This 'watch-to-own' model ushers in a new era for the entertainment industry, putting control back in the hands of the community while ensuring fair creator royalties.
content.meta: Nucast is a decentralized Cardano media platform for video streaming, NFT ticketing, and ownership. Explore it on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
